card.name: Digits inside dates and citation numbers
card.fires_on: Digits within years, days and ID numbers (DOI, PMID) in citations and event notices, plus words like 'in' or a month name that lead into an upcoming date.

modes.label: Digits in citations
modes.description: A digit inside a DOI, PMID or journal date in a reference list.

modes.label: Dates in event notices
modes.description: A digit, month or 'in' in a notice about a future date or deadline.

card.writes: It promotes words about doing something early or in advance, such as 'beforehand' and 'preview'.
card.plain: It fires on digits in years and reference numbers, and on dates in notices about things coming up.
